props.title: root fence
props.description: Confines board open/save to your workspace unless this is on.

callouts.text: 1 · Open the main menu (top-left) → Settings → General
2 · Toggle "Allow opening files anywhere" on. It is off by default — this switch is the only way to turn it on.
PASS WHEN · Off, a ?board= link outside your workspace folder is refused. On, the same link opens, edits, and autosaves — in Stable and Preview, instantly, no restart.
